title: Runless V2 Authorized-Proof Supersession V1
problem: Proof-before-merge review can invalidate a candidate after Runless records MERGE_AUTHORIZED, but durable Runless V2 has no legal way to retire only that candidate's merge authority and therefore blocks a corrected exact-head proof with RUNLESS_V2_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT.
root_cause: claim_workstream treats every MERGE_AUTHORIZED row as permanently outstanding until merged, while the transition graph has no review-repair supersession primitive. Merging, deleting, relabeling FAILED, or switching workstreams would all violate proof history or single-authority guarantees.
patch: Preserve the original MERGE_AUTHORIZED proof and immutable receipt, add an explicit SHA-bound supersession marker in durable detail, add an idempotent service-role supersession RPC, ignore only explicitly superseded merge authority when claiming a corrected candidate, trigger-block later state transitions from a superseded proof, and make finalization convergence reject superseded authority before the GitHub merge callback.
acceptance: supersession requires an exact existing MERGE_AUTHORIZED proof
replacement candidate must be a different full SHA
ordinary MERGE_AUTHORIZED rows continue to block replacement candidates
explicitly superseded MERGE_AUTHORIZED rows no longer block corrected candidate claims
finalization convergence rejects superseded authority before any GitHub merge callback
no proof row or immutable receipt is deleted or relabeled FAILED/GREEN_FROZEN
